newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech SPT shares up on fundamentals-dealers.
newsitem.headline: Czech SPT shares up on fundamentals-dealers.

text.p: Shares in the most heavily capitalised company on the Prague bourse, SPT Telecom a.s., posted solid gains during continuous trading on Thursday with dealers citing strong company fundamentals.
SPT was up 45 crowns to 3,415 at 1105 GMT.
"Recently, I've read a series of surveys from recognised brokerage firms...and everyone says that people should be overweight on Telecom," said Radek Vavra of Citicorp Securities.
"Telecom is roughly 20 percent of the (PX50) index, a fundamentally healthy company which would not be dramatically hit be the devaluation of the crown so the prospects are pretty bright," he added.
The Czech crown came under severe speculative pressure from abroad in May forcing the central bank to float the currency.
The crown has fallen by around 2.5 percent against the mark since the flotation but has been held up by high interest rates. The last resort Lombard rate remains at 50 percent.
